annotations.title: Subscribe an email to new developments or construction

description: Use this when the person asks to be emailed about new-build projects matching a filter (daily) or new construction licensed in one municipality (weekly). Do not use it to have flatin.pt contact them (`request_consultation`) or to see what is on sale now (`search_newbuilds`). Ask the person first; nothing is active until they click the confirmation email. `city` is required for construction and `parish` works only there; `typology`, the prices and `on_sale` work only with new_developments. The answer is the same whether or not the address was already subscribed: never say it was.

city.description: Municipality (Lisboa or Lisbon). Required for construction; empty means all of Portugal for new_developments

client.description: Optional. Your app's host or name: recorded as the request's source

language.description: The person's language: the consent text and the emails come in it. uk is accepted as ua.

on_sale.description: Optional, new_developments: only developments on sale

parish.description: Optional, construction only: a parish (freguesia) of that municipality

price_max.description: Optional, new_developments: maximum price in euros

price_min.description: Optional, new_developments: minimum price in euros

typology.description: Optional. Bedroom counts wanted (T2 = two bedrooms)

what.description: new_developments: new-build developments matching the filter, daily email when something new appears. construction: newly licensed construction in a municipality ("what is being built"), weekly

name: subscribe_digest

anyOf.description: Always the same, whatever the address's state: a confirmation email was requested; nothing is active until the person clicks it.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Subscribe an email to new developments or construction
